news.title: Karthi's Quick OTT Debuts Spark Concerns for Theaters
news.summary: Tamil star Karthi's recent films like Sardar 2 and Vaa Vaathiyar have transitioned to Amazon Prime Video merely weeks after their theatrical releases due to weak box office performances. This recurring short window has alarmed trade analysts, who fear that rapid streaming availability will diminish advance bookings and hurt cinema hall revenues.

news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Crunch as Streaming Platforms Slash Budgets and Post-Theatrical Deals
news.summary: Tollywood is encountering a major hurdle as digital streaming platforms significantly reduce their acquisition budgets and enforce stricter financial limits. With post-theatrical deals no longer guaranteeing massive pre-release recoveries, producers of large-scale and medium-range ventures are facing substantial risks. Consequently, industry stakeholders may need to rely more heavily on box-office performance and controlled production budgets.
